statement: Everything that changed between the pre-registration (commit f4d80b0) and the measured run, with the reason. Committed and pushed before the measured run. The thresholds, the arms, the models, the held-out items and the examples did not change.

entries.what: A development set (data/dev.json, tools/prepare-dev.mjs): 40 support, 40 security (10 spam) and 35 HR items drawn from the training side of each dataset, disjoint from every held-out item and every example (checked by the tool).
entries.why: So that smoke tests and prompt writing never touch the held-out items. Disclosure: the first two plumbing smoke tests (before this set existed) ran 4 held-out items per department through the line; those answers were used only to find bugs, and the prompts were then written against the development set.

entries.what: The prompts were written against the development set. The security station now asks "Is this SMS spam?" and answers with JSON {"spam": "yes" | "no"}, which the kernel maps to spam / legit. It is still schema-constrained, still uses the same six examples, and is graded against the same labels.
entries.why: Measured on the 40 development items with the 1.5B station model: the first prompt ("label it legit or spam") scored 21 of 40, below answering "legit" every time (30 of 40); the yes/no form with the examples scored 34 of 40. Variants tried and their scores are in the README.

entries.what: Engine faults are handled and reported, not hidden. On this laptop the WebGPU device is occasionally lost mid-run (Chrome reports DXGI_ERROR_DEVICE_HUNG from the Intel Iris Xe driver). A node now rebuilds its engine and asks again; if its browser process can no longer use the GPU, it stops taking work (its items stay in its own storage) and the harness relaunches it with the same profile, re-links it, and logs an UNPLANNED RESTART. Each node also warms up with one plain and one schema-constrained answer before it takes work; the warm-up is inside the measured cold start.
entries.why: Found in the development runs: without this, a lost device turned into lost or empty answers. Every unplanned restart during the measured run is listed in the summary and the timeline.

entries.what: Every answer the desk records, the verifier re-checks and the page re-scores is rebuilt from the signed hop outputs by one kernel function (outcomeFromHops), and the gold labels are read from the published data files.
entries.why: So a result can never say more than its receipts.
